verdict.rationale: Rive documents open-source runtime libraries for loading and controlling animations, with a web runtime API for parameters and data binding (autoBind, bindViewModelInstance). It also offers programmatic paths into the editor: an MCP connection, RML text-as-code for building files with coding agents, and a CLI mentioned only in one marketing line. However, no general public HTTP/REST API was found (all OpenAPI/Swagger probes returned 404), so driving the product itself means mixing runtime SDKs, MCP and RML rather than using one documented public API. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/HTTP API or OpenAPI spec for the platform and editor, detailed CLI reference docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic control.
